event.lawsuit_aesthetic_pollution.desc: Neighbor sues for aesthetic pollution. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_aesthetic_pollution.res0: Proper landscaping softens the mine's silhouette. Expensive, and it genuinely looks better.
event.lawsuit_aesthetic_pollution.res1: The mine argues that beauty is subjective. The judge, visibly, disagrees. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_aesthetic_pollution.res2: An actual architect gets hired to redesign the mine's visible profile. Expensive, and it works.
event.lawsuit_aesthetic_pollution.title: Aesthetic Pollution
event.lawsuit_ambulance_chaser.desc: Ambulance chaser lawyer appears. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_ambulance_chaser.res0: A preemptive settlement gets offered before the lawyer can find any more plaintiffs.
event.lawsuit_ambulance_chaser.res1: The lawyer gets ignored entirely. He does not go away; he goes and finds two hundred more clients.
event.lawsuit_ambulance_chaser.res2: The ambulance chaser gets hired directly as in-house counsel. If you can't beat him, retain him. $250 leaves the account every day for 14 days.
event.lawsuit_ambulance_chaser.title: Ambulance Chaser
event.lawsuit_animal_rights.desc: Animal rights group sues for displaced "endangered gravel beetles". The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_animal_rights.res0: A dedicated beetle sanctuary gets carved out of unused land. Expensive, and genuinely good for the ecology score.
event.lawsuit_animal_rights.res1: The mine denies the endangered beetles even exist. The denial does not hold up well under scrutiny. Blasting is banned for 48 hours.
event.lawsuit_animal_rights.res2: The beetles get carefully relocated to a nearby reserve. Cheaper than a sanctuary, and it satisfies the claim.
event.lawsuit_animal_rights.title: Animal Rights
event.lawsuit_back_taxes.desc: Government demands back-taxes on unreported ore. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_back_taxes.res0: The unreported ore's back taxes get paid in full. Expensive, and it lowers the corruption exposure for real.
event.lawsuit_back_taxes.res1: The books get 'creatively' adjusted instead of paying up. Cheaper, and it will not hold up forever.
event.lawsuit_back_taxes.res2: A tax lawyer gets hired to negotiate the amount down through entirely legal channels. $250 leaves the account every day for 14 days.
event.lawsuit_back_taxes.title: Back Taxes
event.lawsuit_bad_coffee.desc: Workers sue for "psychological damage from break room coffee". Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_bad_coffee.res0: A proper espresso machine gets installed. The 'psychological damage from coffee' claims stop overnight.
event.lawsuit_bad_coffee.res1: The claim gets denied outright. Coffee-related trauma, it turns out, is not covered by any policy. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_bad_coffee.res2: An actual barista gets hired for the break room. Modest cost, genuinely better coffee.
event.lawsuit_bad_coffee.title: Bad Coffee
event.lawsuit_blast_limit_fines.desc: Government fines for exceeding blast limits (again). The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_blast_limit_fines.res0: Blast operations get brought fully into compliance with the limits, once and for all. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_blast_limit_fines.res1: The monitoring sensors get quietly recalibrated to read more favorably.
event.lawsuit_blast_limit_fines.res2: Blast sizes get reduced across the board. Slower progress, fewer fines. Crews work 30% slower for 36 hours.
event.lawsuit_blast_limit_fines.title: Blast Limit Fines
event.lawsuit_blaster_discrimination.des: Employee discrimination suit (wanted to be a blaster). The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_blaster_discrimination.res: The employee gets promoted to blaster as originally requested. The case resolves itself. Blaster wages rise 10% permanently.
The matter gets settled quietly without the promotion. It resolves the lawsuit, not the resentment. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
The employee gets handed actual dynamite to prove the point. It goes about as well as expected.
The unqualified blast goes badly wrong. The lawsuit that follows makes the original one look minor.
event.lawsuit_building_code.desc: Building code violations from hasty construction. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_building_code.res0: Every flagged structure gets rebuilt fully to code. Expensive, and it actually fixes the problem. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_building_code.res1: Only the most glaring violations get patched. The rest stays exactly as hastily built as before. Drilling is banned for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_building_code.res2: The building inspector receives a generous envelope. The violations get quietly overlooked.
event.lawsuit_building_code.title: Building Code
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.desc: Workers sue for lack of career development. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.res0: A genuine training program launches, with real qualifications and real career paths. Output climbs 20% for 48 hours.
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.res1: A round of motivational posters goes up instead of an actual program. It fools nobody.
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.res2: Workers get told, plainly, that breaking rocks is the career. It does not land well. The most junior employee hands in their notice and is gone by lunch.
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.res2_alt: Workers get told, plainly, that breaking rocks is the career. It does not land well. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does.
event.lawsuit_career_stagnation.title: Career Stagnation
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.desc: Celebrity sues after chipping nail during mine visit. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.res0: The chipped-nail claim gets settled quietly, well below the celebrity's initial demand.
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.res1: Nothing is offered. The celebrity posts about it, and it goes viral for all the wrong reasons. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.res2: A full endorsement deal turns the chipped nail into free publicity instead of a lawsuit.
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.res2_alt: The endorsement deal falls through and the celebrity sues anyway, nail and all.
event.lawsuit_celeb_nail.title: Celeb Nail
event.lawsuit_class_action.desc: Workers' class action for unsafe conditions. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_class_action.res0: The class action gets settled for every plaintiff. Enormous cost, and real conditions actually improve.
event.lawsuit_class_action.res1: The case is fought in court instead of settled. It goes better than the settlement would have, for once.
event.lawsuit_class_action.res1_alt: Fighting the case backfires badly. The court awards far more than any settlement would have cost.
event.lawsuit_class_action.res2: Union reps get quietly bribed to soften their testimony. Cheaper, and deeply corrupting. Union events drop to 0.5x their usual frequency for 7 days. A charge of $300 hits the books every day for 10 days.
event.lawsuit_class_action.title: Class Action
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.desc: The lawyer you brushed off did not go away. He came back with two hundred plaintiffs and a very large briefcase.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.res0: The ambulance chaser's two hundred plaintiffs get a mega-settlement. Ruinously expensive, and it ends the matter for good.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.res1: The mega-suit gets fought in court at enormous cost, with safety scrutiny intensifying throughout.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.res2: The mine declares bankruptcy and restructures around the mega-suit. Drastic, and it survives, barely. A charge of $1000 hits the books every day for 5 days. A running contract is cancelled, penalty clause and all.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.res2_alt: The mine declares bankruptcy and restructures around the mega-suit. Drastic, and it survives, barely. A charge of $1000 hits the books every day for 5 days. There is no open contract to cancel, so the client has nothing to walk away from.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.res1_alt: The court fight goes badly. The judgment dwarfs even the mega-settlement that was avoided.
event.lawsuit_class_action_mega.title: Class Action Mega
event.lawsuit_contaminated_ore.desc: Product liability: sold contaminated ore, customer's factory turned purple. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_contaminated_ore.res0: A full ore recall goes out to every affected customer, including the one whose factory turned purple.
event.lawsuit_contaminated_ore.res1: The shipping company gets publicly blamed for the contamination instead of the mine. New contracts pay 30% less for 10 days.
event.lawsuit_contaminated_ore.res2: A proper quality control process gets implemented. Expensive, and it actually works.
event.lawsuit_contaminated_ore.title: Contaminated Ore
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.desc: Contractor disputes blast damage to their equipment. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.res0: The contractor's damaged equipment gets replaced outright, no argument. Upkeep costs 15% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.res1: The dispute goes to arbitration, at real expense, and the mine wins.
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.res1_alt: Arbitration rules against the mine. The award is far larger than replacing the equipment would have cost.
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.res2: A subcontractor gets publicly blamed for the damage instead. Cheaper, and reputationally shaky. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_contractor_damage.title: Contractor Damage
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.desc: Criminal negligence charges — game-ending potential. The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.res0: A plea deal is negotiated. Costly, and it keeps everyone with a name tag out of a courtroom.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.res1: The case goes to trial and, against the odds, ends in acquittal.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.res1_a: The trial ends in a guilty verdict. The fine is the largest single expense the mine has ever recorded.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.res2: Key executives quietly relocate to a jurisdiction with no extradition treaty. Expensive, and very final. One manager quits on the spot.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.res2_a: Key executives quietly relocate to a jurisdiction with no extradition treaty. Expensive, and very final. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does.
event.lawsuit_criminal_negligence.title: Criminal Negligence
event.lawsuit_data_breach.desc: Data breach: employee records leaked, everyone's dynamite allergies exposed. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_data_breach.res0: Every affected employee gets formally notified of the breach, along with credit monitoring. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_data_breach.res1: The breach gets covered up entirely. It works, until it very much doesn't. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_data_breach.res2: A proper cybersecurity overhaul follows the breach. Expensive, and the next attempt actually fails. A charge of $250 hits the books every day for 14 days.
event.lawsuit_data_breach.title: Data Breach
event.lawsuit_divorce_subpoena.desc: Divorce lawyer subpoenas mine records. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_divorce_subpoena.res0: The subpoena gets fully complied with. Tedious, and legally uneventful.
event.lawsuit_divorce_subpoena.res1: The relevant documents get quietly shredded before anyone can properly request them. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_divorce_subpoena.res2: A full, transparent audit trail gets provided, well beyond what was actually requested.
event.lawsuit_divorce_subpoena.title: Divorce Subpoena
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion.desc: Class action: chronic dust inhalation fashion damage. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion.res0: The dust-damaged wardrobe claims get settled directly, dry-cleaning bills and all.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion.res1: The claims get lowballed. The plaintiffs' lawyer starts talking about an appeal.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion.res2: Local dry cleaners get quietly paid to downplay how bad the dust damage really is.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion.title: Dust Fashion
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion_appeal.desc: Another envelope from a law firm. The plaintiffs did not like the lowball offer, and they are appealing. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion_appeal.res0: The appeal gets settled for well more than the original offer. Expensive, and it finally ends. $600 leaves the account every day for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion_appeal.res1: A technicality wins the appeal in court. Cheap, and the press coverage is brutal.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion_appeal.res2: The appellate judge gets bribed. Risky at this level of scrutiny, and it works, for now.
event.lawsuit_dust_fashion_appeal.title: Dust Fashion Appeal
event.lawsuit_env_cleanup_order.desc: Environmental cleanup order from government. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_env_cleanup_order.res0: A full government-ordered cleanup runs its course. Expensive, thorough, and genuinely restorative. Every crew downs tools for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_env_cleanup_order.res1: A minimal cleanup satisfies the letter of the order without its spirit. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_env_cleanup_order.res2: The toxic report gets buried before regulators ever see the full extent of it.
event.lawsuit_env_cleanup_order.title: Env Cleanup Order
event.lawsuit_environmental_agency.desc: EPA environmental investigation. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_environmental_agency.res0: The mine complies fully with the EPA's findings. Expensive, thorough, and genuinely cleaner.
event.lawsuit_environmental_agency.res1: The inspector gets bribed to soften the report. Cheaper, and the underlying problem stays exactly where it was. Blasting is banned for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_environmental_agency.res2: A partial fix addresses the most visible violations, leaving the rest for another investigation. Upkeep costs 20% more for 10 days.
event.lawsuit_environmental_agency.title: Environmental Agency
event.lawsuit_existential_dread.desc: Workers' comp for "existential dread caused by explosions". Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_existential_dread.res0: A licensed therapist gets hired to address the workforce's existential dread. Expensive, and it genuinely helps. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_existential_dread.res1: The claim is denied outright. Existential dread, it turns out, is not covered by any policy. Morale falls by 2 per hour for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_existential_dread.res2: A meditation room opens near the blast zone. Ironic location, genuinely calming effect.
event.lawsuit_existential_dread.title: Existential Dread
event.lawsuit_explosion_names.desc: Class action over emotional distress from explosion names. The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_explosion_names.res0: Blast names get quietly sanitized across the board. 'Big Bertha' becomes 'Unit 7'.
event.lawsuit_explosion_names.res1: The mine doubles down on the colorful blast names. The lawsuit does not appreciate the commitment. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_explosion_names.res2: A small sensitivity committee reviews future blast names before they go public.
event.lawsuit_explosion_names.title: Explosion Names
event.lawsuit_farmer_dust.desc: Neighboring farmer: dust ruined his "artisanal organic gravel crop". The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_farmer_dust.res0: Dust suppression gets installed near the property line. Expensive, and the 'artisanal gravel crop' survives.
event.lawsuit_farmer_dust.res1: The dust is denied outright, despite the visible gray film on every visible surface of the farm. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_farmer_dust.res2: The entire 'crop' gets bought out at a generous price. Nobody quite understands what was being farmed.
event.lawsuit_farmer_dust.title: Farmer Dust
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.desc: Ghost of former miner files posthumous complaint (fantastical). Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.res0: A memorial shrine gets built for the deceased miner. Modest cost, and the haunting quiets down. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.res1: An exorcist gets hired to handle the posthumous complaint. It works, mostly, eventually.
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.res2: A full ghost-satisfaction settlement gets negotiated, whatever that turns out to mean in practice.
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.res2_alt: The ghost remains unsatisfied despite the settlement. The haunting continues, now with legal precedent.
event.lawsuit_ghost_miner.title: Ghost Miner
event.lawsuit_historical_artifact.desc: Historical society: you blasted a "priceless" 200-year-old rock pile. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_historical_artifact.res0: The blasted rock pile gets fully restored, stone by stone, under expert supervision. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_historical_artifact.res1: The incident gets covered up. The historical society keeps asking questions nobody answers.
event.lawsuit_historical_artifact.res2: Remaining fragments get donated to a local museum with a respectful plaque.
event.lawsuit_historical_artifact.title: Historical Artifact
event.lawsuit_inspector_union.desc: Mine inspectors union demands better inspection conditions. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_inspector_union.res0: A proper inspector's lounge gets built. Small cost, noticeably smoother inspections after.
event.lawsuit_inspector_union.res1: Hard hats get issued to inspectors as a token gesture. It satisfies the bare minimum of the demand.
event.lawsuit_inspector_union.res2: Certain areas quietly become an 'inspector-free zone'. Convenient, and deeply improper.
event.lawsuit_inspector_union.title: Inspector Union
event.lawsuit_insurance_counter.desc: Insurance company sues YOU for filing too many claims. The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_insurance_counter.res0: The insurer's countersuit gets settled outright. Expensive, and the policy stays in force.
event.lawsuit_insurance_counter.res1: A genuine safety improvement program launches to prove the claims were legitimate.
event.lawsuit_insurance_counter.res2: Claim records get quietly falsified to look less frequent than they were. $600 leaves the account every day for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_insurance_counter.title: Insurance Counter
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.desc: International Court of Mining Justice summons (fantastical). The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.res0: The mine complies fully with the international court's ruling. Extraordinarily expensive, and it actually resolves things.
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.res1: The court's jurisdiction gets ignored outright. It does not recognize borders, and neither, apparently, does its patience. Hauling is suspended for 72 hours.
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.res2: International judges get quietly bribed to rule favorably.
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.res2_alt: The bribery attempt gets exposed publicly. The scandal costs far more than compliance ever would have.
event.lawsuit_intl_mining_court.title: Intl Mining Court
event.lawsuit_mountaineer.desc: Professional mountaineer sues for ruining the mountain. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_mountaineer.res0: A mountain restoration fund gets established to address the mountaineer's complaint.
event.lawsuit_mountaineer.res1: The mine points out, correctly, that it operates a pit, not a peak. The mountaineer is unconvinced.
event.lawsuit_mountaineer.res2: A climbing wall gets built on-site as a good-faith gesture. Unexpectedly popular with the crews too. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_mountaineer.title: Mountaineer
event.lawsuit_neighbor_vibrations.desc: Mrs. Henderson's 47 porcelain cats shattered by vibrations. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_neighbor_vibrations.res0: Every one of Mrs. Henderson's forty-seven porcelain cats gets replaced, itemized and appraised.
event.lawsuit_neighbor_vibrations.res1: Vibrations are denied outright, despite the visible crack running through her mantelpiece. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_neighbor_vibrations.res2: Vibration dampeners get installed, but the retrofit itself rattles the neighborhood for a week. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_neighbor_vibrations.title: Neighbor Vibrations
event.lawsuit_noise_infractions.desc: Noise ordinance violation, multiple infractions. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_noise_infractions.res0: Real noise barriers go up around the site. Expensive, and the infractions actually stop.
event.lawsuit_noise_infractions.res1: Only the fines get paid. The noise, and the infractions, continue exactly as before. A charge of $1000 hits the books every day for 5 days.
event.lawsuit_noise_infractions.res2: The noise inspector gets a generous envelope. The infraction count drops on paper only.
event.lawsuit_noise_infractions.title: Noise Infractions
event.lawsuit_noise_restraining.desc: Noise complaint escalates to restraining order against your explosives. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_noise_restraining.res0: Sound barriers go up around the blast zone. Expensive, and the restraining order gets lifted.
event.lawsuit_noise_restraining.res1: The judge enjoys an unusually generous golf trip right before the ruling comes down favorably. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_noise_restraining.res2: Blast scheduling shifts to quieter hours. A modest, genuine compromise. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_noise_restraining.title: Noise Restraining
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.desc: IP dispute: neighboring mine claims you stole their ore name "Boomite". Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.res0: The ore gets quietly renamed to avoid the dispute entirely. Cheap, and a little embarrassing. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.res1: The name gets defended in court at real expense, and the mine keeps 'Boomite'.
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.res1_alt: The court sides with the neighboring mine. The name has to go anyway, after a much larger legal bill.
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.res2: The trademark gets bought outright from the neighboring mine. Expensive, and the dispute simply ends.
event.lawsuit_ore_name_ip.title: Ore Name Ip
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.desc: OSHA investigation: hardhats used as soup bowls. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.opt1: Send the Inspector a Gift Basket
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.res0: A full OSHA overhaul follows the hardhat-as-soup-bowl incident. Expensive, and long overdue. Upkeep costs 15% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.res1: The inspector receives an unusually thoughtful gift basket. The citation gets quietly downgraded.
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.res2: The bare legal minimum gets fixed. Hardhats stop being soup bowls; little else changes. Drilling is banned for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_osha_hardhats.title: OSHA Hardhats
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.desc: Regulatory fine for paperwork violations. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.opt0: Pay the Fine and Refile Documents
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.res0: The fine gets paid and every flagged document gets properly refiled.
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.res1: Only the most urgent paperwork gets fixed. The rest stays exactly as disorganized as before.
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.res2: The missing paperwork gets quietly forged to look like it always existed.
event.lawsuit_paperwork_fine.title: Paperwork Fine
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.desc: Patent troll claims ownership of your blasting technique. Your legal department is earning their keep today.
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.res0: The patent gets licensed rather than fought. Expensive, and the paperwork simply ends.
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.res1: The patent claim gets fought in court, at enormous expense, and loses.
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.res1_alt: The court sides with the troll. The patent holds, and the legal bill is worse than licensing would have been.
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.res2: A counter-suit gets filed against the troll's own dubious patent portfolio. A charge of $250 hits the books every day for 14 days.
event.lawsuit_patent_troll.title: Patent Troll
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.desc: PETA sues for distressing local goat population. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.res0: A dedicated goat sanctuary gets established near the site. Expensive, and the goats seem content.
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.res1: The mine insists the goats are fine. The goats, photographed mid-panic, disagree visually. New contracts pay 30% less for 10 days.
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.res2: The goats get carefully relocated to calmer pastures well away from the blast zone.
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.res2_alt: The relocated goats wander straight back to their original, noisier pasture within days.
event.lawsuit_peta_goats.title: Peta Goats
event.lawsuit_property_values.desc: Neighbor sues over plummeting property values. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_property_values.res0: Neighbors get compensated for the drop in property values, itemized down to the square foot.
event.lawsuit_property_values.res1: A friendly appraiser gets quietly persuaded to revise the numbers downward. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_property_values.res2: A landscaped buffer zone goes up between the mine and the neighborhood. A visible, partial gesture.
event.lawsuit_property_values.title: Property Values
event.lawsuit_school_exams.desc: Local school sues: blasts interrupt exams. The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_school_exams.res0: Blast scheduling shifts entirely away from exam periods. A simple, effective fix. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_school_exams.res1: The school's exam hall gets fully soundproofed instead of changing the blast schedule.
event.lawsuit_school_exams.res2: Nothing changes. The mine's position is that the children can cope with the timing. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_school_exams.title: School Exams
event.lawsuit_shareholder_suit.desc: Shareholder derivative suit. The lawyers are circling like vultures.
event.lawsuit_shareholder_suit.res0: A real governance reform program gets adopted to satisfy the shareholders' derivative suit.
event.lawsuit_shareholder_suit.res1: The shareholders get fought in court instead of appeased. It is expensive and does not win any friends. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_shareholder_suit.res2: Shares get quietly bought back to reduce the number of unhappy voices in the room. $250 leaves the account every day for 14 days.
event.lawsuit_shareholder_suit.title: Shareholder Suit
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.desc: Slip-and-fall from mine tour visitor who ignored 14 warning signs. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.res0: The slip-and-fall claim gets settled quietly despite the fourteen ignored warning signs.
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.res1: The case goes to court, relying entirely on the fourteen ignored warning signs as evidence.
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.res1_alt: The case gets dismissed outright — fourteen warning signs turn out to be a compelling defense.
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.res2: A fifteenth warning sign gets added. It does not stop the lawsuits, but it looks thorough. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_slip_and_fall.title: Slip And Fall
event.lawsuit_superpowers.desc: Former employee claims mine gave them superpowers, wants royalties. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_superpowers.res0: The superpower claim gets dismissed outright as exactly as absurd as it sounds.
event.lawsuit_superpowers.res1: A genuine scientific study gets commissioned to investigate the claim. It finds nothing, expensively. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.lawsuit_superpowers.res2: A quiet NDA settles the matter before anyone asks to see the alleged superpowers demonstrated.
event.lawsuit_superpowers.title: Superpowers
event.lawsuit_tax_evasion.desc: Tax evasion investigation: "creative accounting with dynamite receipts". The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_tax_evasion.res0: Back taxes get paid in full, with penalties, closing the investigation cleanly.
event.lawsuit_tax_evasion.res1: Funds move into fresh offshore accounts mid-investigation. Bold, and it does not go unnoticed forever. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_tax_evasion.res2: A voluntary disclosure gets filed before the investigators find everything themselves. $600 leaves the account every day for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_tax_evasion.title: Tax Evasion
event.lawsuit_tell_all_book.desc: Former employee writes tell-all book "The Pit of Despair". Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_tell_all_book.res0: An injunction blocks the book's release. Legally effective, and it makes the mine look exactly as bad as the book claimed. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_tell_all_book.res1: The mine 'owns the narrative' with its own press tour instead of suing. Cheaper, and surprisingly effective.
event.lawsuit_tell_all_book.res2: Every copy in the first print run gets quietly bought up. The second print run sells even better because of it.
event.lawsuit_tell_all_book.title: Tell All Book
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.desc: Competitor sues for unfair blasting practices. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.res0: A standard legal defense gets mounted against the unfair-practices claim.
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.res1: A countersuit gets filed against the competitor, and against the odds, it wins.
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.res1_alt: The countersuit fails badly. The competitor's original claim looks stronger for the attempt.
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.res2: A quiet settlement gets reached directly with the competitor, corruption included.
event.lawsuit_unfair_blasting.title: Unfair Blasting
event.lawsuit_union_right.desc: Workers sue for right to unionize. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_union_right.res0: The right to unionize gets recognized without a fight. Cheap, and morale climbs immediately. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_union_right.res1: Unionization gets fought at every legal turn. Expensive, and it does not go over well. Every crew downs tools for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_union_right.res2: A company-friendly 'puppet union' gets installed instead of the real thing.
event.lawsuit_union_right.title: Union Right
event.lawsuit_unpaid_supplier.desc: Supplier sues for unpaid invoices. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_unpaid_supplier.res0: The overdue invoices get paid in full, with a little interest thrown in for goodwill.
event.lawsuit_unpaid_supplier.res1: The invoices get disputed line by line. The supplier is not amused by the delay tactics. Explosives cost 25% more for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_unpaid_supplier.res2: The relevant paperwork gets conveniently 'lost' in the filing system.
event.lawsuit_unpaid_supplier.title: Unpaid Supplier
event.lawsuit_village_coalition.desc: Joint lawsuit from multiple villages. The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition.res0: A mega-settlement resolves every village's claim in one comprehensive, expensive stroke.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition.res1: A partial settlement satisfies some villages and visibly annoys the rest.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition.res2: Village mayors get individually and quietly bought off, one by one. $300 leaves the account every day for 10 days.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition.title: Village Coalition
event.lawsuit_village_coalition_2.desc: The villages you only half-satisfied have compared notes. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition_2.res0: A full settlement funds a genuine community investment fund for every village involved. Lawsuit events drop to 0.5x their usual frequency for 7 days. New contracts pay 15% more for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition_2.res1: Individual deals get struck with each village separately, dividing the coalition's leverage.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition_2.res2: A slow government mediation process resolves the coalition's claims fairly, if not quickly.
event.lawsuit_village_coalition_2.title: Village Coalition 2
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.desc: Whistleblower protection lawsuit. Another envelope from a law firm. Never good news.
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.res0: The whistleblower gets formal, real protection. Corruption exposure genuinely drops as a result. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.res1: The whistleblower gets quietly retaliated against instead. Illegal, and it does not stay quiet for long. The most junior employee hands in their notice and is gone by lunch.
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.res1_alt: The whistleblower gets quietly retaliated against instead. Illegal, and it does not stay quiet for long. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does.
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.res2: An anonymous hotline gets set up as a middle ground between protection and retaliation.
event.lawsuit_whistleblower.title: Whistleblower
event.lawsuit_wrongful_death.desc: Wrongful death suit from bereaved family. Someone's lawyer has been very busy.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_death.res0: The wrongful death suit is settled in full. A staggering sum, and a real, if late, gesture toward the family.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_death.res1: The family gets intimidated into dropping the case. Cheaper, and morally indefensible. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_death.res2: A memorial fund gets established in the deceased's name, alongside real safety improvements. $600 leaves the account every day for 7 days. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_death.title: Wrongful Death
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.desc: Wrongful termination: fired employee says they were "too good at blasting". The courthouse knows your name by now.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.res0: The blaster gets rehired with back pay. Expensive, and it turns out they really were that good. A new blaster signs on at no cost.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.res1: The termination gets defended in court, expensively, and holds up.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.res1_: The court overturns the termination anyway. The legal bill dwarfs what a settlement would have cost.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.res2: A generous severance package settles the matter quietly, without admitting anything. $250 leaves the account every day for 14 days. Every employee pockets a $500 bonus.
event.lawsuit_wrongful_termination.title: Wrongful Termination
event.mafia_armored_vehicles.desc: Armored vehicles at a "discount". Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_armored_vehicles.res0: A fleet of decommissioned armored personnel carriers arrives at a suspiciously good price. Upkeep costs 15% less for 7 days.
event.mafia_armored_vehicles.res1: The offer is passed on. The fleet stays exactly as unarmored as before.
event.mafia_armored_vehicles.res2: A single armored van gets purchased instead of the full fleet. Modest upgrade, modest cost.
event.mafia_armored_vehicles.title: Armored Vehicles
event.mafia_attack_dogs.desc: Mafia attack dogs for security. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_attack_dogs.res0: A pack of trained attack dogs joins site security. Effective, and considerably unsettling to have around. An employee is hurt in the chaos.
event.mafia_attack_dogs.res0_alt: A pack of trained attack dogs joins site security. Effective, and considerably unsettling to have around. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_attack_dogs.res1: The offer is declined. Site security stays exactly as toothless as before.
event.mafia_attack_dogs.res2: A single, unconvincing chihuahua gets adopted as a symbolic gesture toward security.
event.mafia_attack_dogs.title: Attack Dogs
event.mafia_audit_cover.desc: Mob accountant needs your books for audit cover. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_audit_cover.res0: The books get used as cover for the mob's own audit dodge. Lucrative, and ecologically indefensible. Politics events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_audit_cover.res1: The accountant's request is refused. An unspecified consequence is implied shortly after.
event.mafia_audit_cover.res2: A partial cover is offered, just enough to look cooperative without going all in.
event.mafia_audit_cover.res2_alt: The partial cover triggers a full forensic audit instead of avoiding one.
event.mafia_audit_cover.title: Audit Cover
event.mafia_blast_rival.desc: Mob boss wants to blast rival's property. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_blast_rival.res0: The rival's property gets blasted as requested. Profitable, and both safety and ecology take the hit. Blasting is banned for 48 hours.
event.mafia_blast_rival.res1: The request is refused. The boss does not take the refusal well.
event.mafia_blast_rival.res2: A smaller, more deniable 'accident' happens at the rival's property instead of a full blast. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.mafia_blast_rival.title: Blast Rival
event.mafia_boss_birthday.desc: Mob boss birthday party at mine. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_boss_birthday.res0: A full birthday party for the boss takes over the site for an evening. Loud, disruptive, and diplomatically necessary. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.mafia_boss_birthday.res1: The party is declined. The boss does not take the snub gracefully. An employee is hurt in the chaos.
event.mafia_boss_birthday.res1_alt: The party is declined. The boss does not take the snub gracefully. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_boss_birthday.res2: A modest, low-key celebration satisfies the obligation without the full spectacle.
event.mafia_boss_birthday.title: Boss Birthday
event.mafia_casino.desc: Underground casino in storage depot. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_casino.res0: An underground casino opens in the storage depot. Profitable, and safety and wellbeing both quietly erode. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_casino.res1: The casino offer is declined. The storage depot stays exactly as boring and safe as intended.
event.mafia_casino.res2: A modest weekly poker night runs instead of a full casino operation.
event.mafia_casino.title: Casino
event.mafia_corrupt_judge.desc: Corrupt judge offers permanent immunity. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_corrupt_judge.res0: Full judicial immunity is purchased outright. Extremely expensive, and legal troubles simply stop existing. Lawsuit events drop to 0.5x their usual frequency for 7 days.
event.mafia_corrupt_judge.res1: The offer is declined. Legal matters proceed through the actual court system, slowly and honestly.
event.mafia_corrupt_judge.res2: A partial arrangement softens the judge's rulings without buying full immunity.
event.mafia_corrupt_judge.title: Corrupt Judge
event.mafia_drug_lab.desc: Drug lab in abandoned section. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_drug_lab.res0: The lab in the abandoned section gets demolished outright. Costly, and genuinely the responsible choice.
event.mafia_drug_lab.res1: The lab is tolerated in exchange for a cut. Profitable, and both safety and ecology quietly suffer. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_drug_lab.res2: The lab gets relocated somewhere less conspicuous rather than shut down entirely.
event.mafia_drug_lab.title: Drug Lab
event.mafia_enforcer.desc: Enforcer as your "security consultant". Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_enforcer.res0: The enforcer joins as 'security consultant'. Safety numbers improve; nobody enjoys having him around. A new manager signs on at no cost. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_enforcer.res1: The offer is refused. The refusal does not sit well with whoever made it. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_enforcer.res1_alt: The offer is refused. The refusal does not sit well with whoever made it. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_enforcer.res2: A legitimate licensed security firm gets hired instead. More expensive, considerably less menacing.
event.mafia_enforcer.title: Enforcer
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.desc: Mob enforcer wants workers' comp. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.res0: The enforcer's workers' comp claim gets quietly paid out. Expensive, and it keeps the peace for now. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.res1: The claim is denied. The enforcer is, predictably, furious about it. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.res1_alt: The claim is denied. The enforcer is, predictably, furious about it. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.res2: A fake cast and a doctor's note settle the claim for less than the real thing would have cost.
event.mafia_enforcer_comp.title: Enforcer Comp
event.mafia_exclusive_buyer.desc: Exclusive ore buyer at premium prices. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_exclusive_buyer.res0: An exclusive supply deal is signed at premium prices. Lucrative, with quiet strings attached. New contracts pay 15% more for 7 days.
event.mafia_exclusive_buyer.res1: The exclusive deal is declined. Standard buyers get the ore at standard prices, as usual.
event.mafia_exclusive_buyer.res2: A partial deal moves a fraction of the ore through the premium buyer, hedging the risk.
event.mafia_exclusive_buyer.title: Exclusive Buyer
event.mafia_fake_alibis.desc: Fake alibis using timesheets. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_fake_alibis.res0: Timesheets get quietly forged into airtight alibis for people who were never actually on site. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_fake_alibis.res1: The forgery request is refused. Safety around the office quietly declines afterward.
event.mafia_fake_alibis.res2: A vaguer, less committal version of the alibi gets produced — plausible, deniable, unremarkable.
event.mafia_fake_alibis.title: Fake Alibis
event.mafia_fake_certificates.desc: Counterfeit ore certificates for sale. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_fake_certificates.res0: Counterfeit ore certificates move through the books. Profitable, and the ecology numbers behind them are pure fiction. New contracts pay 15% more for 7 days.
event.mafia_fake_certificates.res1: The offer is declined. Every certificate the mine issues stays exactly as real as it claims to be.
event.mafia_fake_certificates.res2: A small batch of forged certificates slips through quietly, mixed in with the legitimate ones.
event.mafia_fake_certificates.res2_alt: The forged batch gets caught during a routine buyer inspection. Expensive, and very publicly embarrassing.
event.mafia_fake_certificates.title: Fake Certificates
event.mafia_family_reunion.desc: Crime family reunion at canteen. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_family_reunion.res0: The crime family reunion takes over the canteen for a full weekend. Loud, disruptive, and non-negotiable. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.mafia_family_reunion.res1: The reunion is declined. The canteen stays available, but the family takes offence and safety takes a hit. An employee is hurt in the chaos.
event.mafia_family_reunion.res1_alt: The reunion is declined. The canteen stays available, but the family takes offence and safety takes a hit. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_family_reunion.res2: A smaller buffet-only gathering satisfies the request without the full reunion.
event.mafia_family_reunion.title: Family Reunion
event.mafia_fbi_mole.desc: FBI undercover agent suspected. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_fbi_mole.res0: The suspected mole gets fired on the spot, no investigation, no due process. One employee leaves the crew.
event.mafia_fbi_mole.res0_alt: There is nobody left to fire. The mole, if there ever was one, had already left.
event.mafia_fbi_mole.res1: Full cooperation is offered to the FBI instead of a witch hunt. It lowers corruption exposure genuinely.
event.mafia_fbi_mole.res2: A paranoid sweep of the whole crew turns up nothing conclusive, and a lot of hurt feelings. Morale falls by 2 per hour for 12 hours.
event.mafia_fbi_mole.title: Fbi Mole
event.mafia_fee_hike.desc: Protection fee increases. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_fee_hike.res0: The higher protection fee gets paid without a fight. Expensive, and the arson threats stay theoretical.
event.mafia_fee_hike.res1: The hike is refused. A suspicious fire breaks out in a storage shed shortly after. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.mafia_fee_hike.res2: A counter-offer gets negotiated down from the hiked rate.
event.mafia_fee_hike.res2_alt: The counter-offer is rejected outright, and the intimidation escalates well past the original ask.
event.mafia_fee_hike.title: Fee Hike
event.mafia_fight_club.desc: Underground fight club in the pit after hours. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_fight_club.res0: The underground fight club runs unimpeded after hours in the pit. Profitable, and safety numbers take a beating, literally. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_fight_club.res0_alt: The underground fight club runs unimpeded after hours in the pit. Profitable, and safety numbers take a beating, literally. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_fight_club.res1: The fight club gets shut down entirely. Quieter nights, fewer black eyes at the morning briefing.
event.mafia_fight_club.res2: The fights continue but under looser 'regulation' — a referee, some rules, marginally fewer injuries.
event.mafia_fight_club.title: Fight Club
event.mafia_gambling_ring.desc: Underground gambling ring in the mine. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_gambling_ring.res0: The underground gambling ring is allowed to operate freely below the site. Profitable, and morale and safety both suffer for it. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_gambling_ring.res1: The ring gets shut down. Morale dips slightly among the regulars, but the site is cleaner for it.
event.mafia_gambling_ring.res2: A modest house cut is taken instead of shutting it down. A quiet, steady, morally gray income stream.
event.mafia_gambling_ring.title: Gambling Ring
event.mafia_geology_nerd.desc: Mob boss genuinely interested in geology. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_geology_nerd.res0: The boss's genuine passion for geology turns into real, funded field trips. Unexpectedly wholesome, unexpectedly good for morale. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_geology_nerd.res1: The boss's rock enthusiasm gets mocked openly. He does not take it well. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_geology_nerd.res1_alt: The boss's rock enthusiasm gets mocked openly. He does not take it well. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_geology_nerd.res2: A small rock collection gets curated as a gift for the boss's private study.
event.mafia_geology_nerd.res2_alt: The 'gift' collection turns out to contain genuinely valuable gems nobody had appraised.
event.mafia_geology_nerd.title: Geology Nerd
event.mafia_hide_witness.desc: Witness needs to "disappear" (hide in mine). Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_hide_witness.res0: The witness gets hidden somewhere deep in the mine's least-inspected corner. Profitable, and dangerously compromising. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_hide_witness.res1: Hiding anyone is refused outright. A quiet, unspecified consequence is implied and never explained.
event.mafia_hide_witness.res2: A quiet tip goes to witness protection instead. Risky, and it earns a measure of goodwill with the right people.
event.mafia_hide_witness.title: Hide Witness
event.mafia_hit_offer.desc: Eliminate a competitor's key employee. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_hit_offer.res0: The hit is carried out. A rival's key employee disappears from the org chart, permanently.
event.mafia_hit_offer.res1: The offer is refused outright. The people making the offer do not take refusal gracefully. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_hit_offer.res1_alt: The offer is refused outright. The people making the offer do not take refusal gracefully. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_hit_offer.res2: The hit gets faked convincingly — a staged disappearance nobody looks too closely at.
event.mafia_hit_offer.res2_alt: The fake gets discovered. The deception costs more in corruption exposure than the real thing would have.
event.mafia_hit_offer.title: Hit Offer
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.desc: Illegal explosive prototype. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.res0: The illegal prototype explosive gets tested on-site. Powerful, and dangerously unregulated.
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.res0_alt: The prototype detonates prematurely during testing. The damage far exceeds what anyone planned for.
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.res1: Testing the prototype is refused outright. Whatever it could do stays theoretical.
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.res2: A small, cautious sample gets tested instead of the full prototype. Limited risk, limited data. Explosives cost 15% less for 7 days.
event.mafia_illegal_explosive.title: Illegal Explosive
event.mafia_informant.desc: Someone's talking to the feds. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_informant.res0: Full cooperation with federal investigators is offered. Costly, and it genuinely lowers the corruption exposure.
event.mafia_informant.res1: The informant is silenced through less-than-legal means. Effective, and safety takes a serious hit. An employee hands in their notice and is gone by lunch.
event.mafia_informant.res1_alt: The informant is silenced through less-than-legal means. Effective, and safety takes a serious hit. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does.
event.mafia_informant.res2: The whole matter is ignored. Everyone waits nervously to see who talks next. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_informant.title: Informant
event.mafia_insurance_scam.desc: Insurance scam opportunity. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.res0: A staged accident nets a large insurance payout. Profitable, and safety statistics take an obvious hit. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.res0_alt: A staged accident nets a large insurance payout. Profitable, and safety statistics take an obvious hit. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.res1: The scam is declined entirely. Insurance premiums stay honest, if unprofitable.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.res2: A smaller, more subtle fraud slips through the claims process.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.res2_alt: The subtle fraud gets caught by the insurer's own investigators. The fine erases the intended gain.
event.mafia_insurance_scam.title: Insurance Scam
event.mafia_mine_lottery.desc: Mafia-run lottery: mine as grand prize (absurd). The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_mine_lottery.res0: The absurd lottery runs its course and the mine collects its cut. Lucrative, chaotic, and safety pays for it.
event.mafia_mine_lottery.res0_alt: The lottery's winner shows up demanding the mine as their prize. Legally dubious, and extremely awkward.
event.mafia_mine_lottery.res1: Running the lottery is refused outright. Vague threats follow, as they tend to.
event.mafia_mine_lottery.res2: The lottery runs, quietly rigged so the 'winner' was always predetermined. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_mine_lottery.title: Mine Lottery
event.mafia_money_laundering.desc: Run numbers through your books. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_money_laundering.res0: The books get run through fully. A large cash injection arrives, no questions asked, no answers given. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_money_laundering.res1: The request is refused. A vague, unpleasant threat follows about workplace safety. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_money_laundering.res1_alt: The request is refused. A vague, unpleasant threat follows about workplace safety. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_money_laundering.res2: A modest amount gets run through the books, carefully, in small enough batches to avoid attention.
event.mafia_money_laundering.res2_alt: The small batches trigger exactly the audit they were meant to avoid.
event.mafia_money_laundering.title: Money Laundering
event.mafia_movie_set.desc: Mine as movie set. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_movie_set.res0: The mine becomes a full mob-movie set for a week. Noisy, disruptive, and unexpectedly lucrative. Crews work 20% slower for 48 hours.
event.mafia_movie_set.res1: The filming request is declined. The mine stays exactly as un-cinematic as before.
event.mafia_movie_set.res2: A brief cameo shoot is allowed instead of full production access. Minor disruption, minor payout.
event.mafia_movie_set.title: Movie Set
event.mafia_naming_rights.desc: Naming rights to rock formation. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_naming_rights.res0: A prominent rock formation gets named after the boss. Modest fee, slightly ridiculous plaque.
event.mafia_naming_rights.res1: The naming offer is declined. The formation stays anonymous, and the ecology score appreciates it.
event.mafia_naming_rights.res2: A small, unobtrusive plaque commemorates the deal instead of a full renaming.
event.mafia_naming_rights.title: Naming Rights
event.mafia_noshow_job.desc: Boss's nephew needs a no-show job. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_noshow_job.res0: The nephew joins payroll and is never seen on site. A quiet, expensive line item.
event.mafia_noshow_job.res1: The request is denied. A vague threat about site safety follows within the week. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_noshow_job.res2: The nephew gets an actual job with actual duties. Expensive, and at least he shows up. A new driller signs on at no cost.
event.mafia_noshow_job.title: Noshow Job
event.mafia_offshore.desc: Offshore account opportunity. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_offshore.res0: A new offshore account opens without much scrutiny. Profitable, and the corruption trail grows accordingly. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_offshore.res1: The opportunity is declined. Every account the mine holds stays exactly where regulators can find it.
event.mafia_offshore.res2: A modest shell company gets set up instead of a full offshore structure.
event.mafia_offshore.res2_alt: The shell company gets flagged and audited within months. The savings evaporate into legal fees.
event.mafia_offshore.title: Offshore
event.mafia_plant_workers.desc: Hire specific "employees" (mob plants). Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_plant_workers.res0: The requested 'employees' get hired, no interview, no questions. Morale and safety both quietly suffer. A new driller signs on at no cost. Morale falls by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_plant_workers.res1: Hiring is refused. Vandalism follows within days, impossible to trace back to anyone specific. Output drops 20% for 48 hours.
event.mafia_plant_workers.res2: The plants get hired but kept under close, deliberate supervision. Costly, and it limits the damage. A new driller signs on at no cost.
event.mafia_plant_workers.title: Plant Workers
event.mafia_police_raid_tip.desc: Anonymous tip about upcoming police raid. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_police_raid_tip.res0: The site gets cleaned house overnight ahead of the raid. Expensive, and the raid finds nothing of note. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.mafia_police_raid_tip.res1: The tip is ignored. The raid happens exactly as warned, and it finds exactly what it was looking for. Every crew downs tools for 24 hours.
event.mafia_police_raid_tip.res2: A partial cleanup handles the most obvious evidence. Cheaper, and it leaves some loose ends.
event.mafia_police_raid_tip.title: Police Raid Tip
event.mafia_protection_racket.desc: "Consulting fee" protection racket. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_protection_racket.res0: The 'consulting fee' is paid without argument. Equipment stays untouched; the invoice is vague on purpose.
event.mafia_protection_racket.res1: Payment is refused. A conveyor belt mysteriously fails the next morning. All work on site halts for 12 hours.
event.mafia_protection_racket.res2: A smaller fee gets negotiated down. Cheaper, and still technically extortion. $300 leaves the account every day for 10 days.
event.mafia_protection_racket.title: Protection Racket
event.mafia_rig_contracts.desc: Rigged contract bidding. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_rig_contracts.res0: Contract bids get quietly rigged in the mine's favor. Profitable, and safety inspectors get noticeably less thorough. New contracts pay 15% more for 7 days.
event.mafia_rig_contracts.res1: The rigging offer is declined. Contracts get won or lost on their own, actual merits.
event.mafia_rig_contracts.res2: A lighter, softer rig nudges the odds without being too obvious about it.
event.mafia_rig_contracts.title: Rig Contracts
event.mafia_rival_gang.desc: Turf war, mine as weapons storage. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_rival_gang.res0: The mine becomes a weapons cache for the turf war. Lucrative, and safety plummets accordingly.
event.mafia_rival_gang.res1: Nothing is offered. The rival gang retaliates against the refusal in a way that is impossible to ignore. One employee ends up in the infirmary. Every crew downs tools for 12 hours.
event.mafia_rival_gang.res1_alt: Nothing is offered. The rival gang retaliates against the refusal in a way that is impossible to ignore. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens. Every crew downs tools for 12 hours.
event.mafia_rival_gang.res2: An anonymous tip goes to the police instead. Risky, and it actually improves the safety picture.
event.mafia_rival_gang.title: Rival Gang
event.mafia_rival_recruit.desc: Rival mob recruits your workers. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_rival_recruit.res0: Loyalty raises go out to everyone the rival mob tried to poach. Expensive, and it works. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_rival_recruit.res1: Nothing is offered. Several workers quietly leave for the rival outfit within the week. One employee quits on the spot.
event.mafia_rival_recruit.res1_alt: Nothing is offered. Several workers quietly leave for the rival outfit within the week. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does.
event.mafia_rival_recruit.res2: A few workers get quietly kept on as double agents, feeding back information from the rival gang.
event.mafia_rival_recruit.title: Rival Recruit
event.mafia_rock_sculpture.desc: Mob boss wants custom rock sculpture for garden. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_rock_sculpture.res0: A genuine sculptural masterpiece gets carved for the boss's garden. Time-consuming, and it buys real favor.
event.mafia_rock_sculpture.res1: The request is declined. The garden stays sculpture-free, and so does the goodwill. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_rock_sculpture.res2: A rare rock specimen gets sold instead of carved. Faster, more profitable, less personal.
event.mafia_rock_sculpture.title: Rock Sculpture
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.desc: Treranium "fell off a truck". A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.res0: The 'fallen off a truck' ore gets quietly absorbed into inventory. Profitable, and the paper trail does not exist. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.res1: The offer is declined outright. The truck, and whoever it fell off of, moves along.
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.res2: A small cut of the smuggled ore gets taken, carefully, just enough to stay under notice.
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.res2_a: The small cut gets noticed anyway. An inspector starts asking pointed questions about inventory discrepancies.
event.mafia_smuggling_opportunity.title: Smuggling Opportunity
event.mafia_stolen_explosives.desc: Stolen explosives found in your depot. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_stolen_explosives.res0: The stolen explosives get reported to the authorities. The right thing to do, and the safest one. Blasting is banned for 12 hours.
event.mafia_stolen_explosives.res1: The explosives get kept and quietly used. Extra material for cheap, and considerably less traceable safety. Explosives cost 15% less for 7 days.
event.mafia_stolen_explosives.res2: The explosives get returned quietly through an intermediary. Nobody official ever hears about it.
event.mafia_stolen_explosives.title: Stolen Explosives
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.desc: Stolen vehicles at discount. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.res0: A fleet of suspiciously cheap vehicles arrives with suspiciously clean paperwork.
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.res1: Vehicles get bought legitimately instead, at full price, with a clean and boring paper trail. Upkeep costs 15% less for 7 days.
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.res2: A single discounted vehicle gets taken, carefully, to limit exposure.
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.res2_alt: The vehicle's VIN gets traced by police within the month. An awkward conversation follows.
event.mafia_stolen_vehicles.title: Stolen Vehicles
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.desc: Gang tattoo artist in break room. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.res0: The tattoo artist sets up shop in the break room. Popular, and needles near heavy machinery is exactly the concern it sounds like. An employee is hurt in the chaos.
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.res0_alt: The tattoo artist sets up shop in the break room. Popular, and needles near heavy machinery is exactly the concern it sounds like. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.res1: The artist is turned away. The break room stays needle-free and slightly less interesting.
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.res2: The shop is allowed weekends only, off the clock. A reasonable compromise nobody's thrilled about.
event.mafia_tattoo_shop.title: Tattoo Shop
event.mafia_therapist.desc: Mafia therapist available. Someone left an unmarked envelope on your desk.
event.mafia_therapist.res0: A mob-connected therapist starts holding sessions on-site. Unconventional, and it genuinely helps. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.mafia_therapist.res1: The offer is declined. Stress management stays exactly as informal as before.
event.mafia_therapist.res2: A cheaper group session format runs instead of individual therapy. Modest help, modest cost.
event.mafia_therapist.title: Therapist
event.mafia_tunnel_courier.desc: Courier service through tunnels. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_tunnel_courier.res0: A courier route opens through the mine's own tunnels. Profitable, and structurally concerning. Hauling is suspended for 12 hours.
event.mafia_tunnel_courier.res1: The tunnel route is declined. The tunnels stay exactly what they were built for.
event.mafia_tunnel_courier.res2: A single one-off shipment moves through the tunnels, just this once.
event.mafia_tunnel_courier.title: Tunnel Courier
event.mafia_union_fix.desc: Offer to "solve" your union problem. A man in a nice suit has a proposition.
event.mafia_union_fix.res0: The union 'problem' gets 'solved' through intimidation. Wellbeing spikes suspiciously fast; safety pays the price. Union events drop to 0.5x their usual frequency for 7 days.
event.mafia_union_fix.res1: The offer is declined. The union problem remains, entirely, an actual labor dispute.
event.mafia_union_fix.res2: A lighter touch of intimidation is applied instead of the full treatment. Still coercion, just quieter.
event.mafia_union_fix.title: Union Fix
event.mafia_vault_found.desc: Mafia vault discovered during blasting. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_vault_found.res0: A hidden mafia vault gets quietly looted during blasting cleanup. A significant, untraceable windfall.
event.mafia_vault_found.res0_alt: The vault turns out to be booby-trapped. The looting attempt goes badly, and safety pays for the surprise.
event.mafia_vault_found.res1: The vault gets reported to the authorities. The right thing to do, and it earns a little goodwill.
event.mafia_vault_found.res2: The contents get quietly split with whoever else knows about the find. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_vault_found.title: Vault Found
event.mafia_waste_dumping.desc: Illegal waste dumping in abandoned shaft. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_waste_dumping.res0: Waste gets dumped straight into the abandoned shaft. Lucrative, and catastrophic for the ecology score. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_waste_dumping.res1: The offer is refused. The shaft stays empty, and so does the payout.
event.mafia_waste_dumping.res2: A smaller, quieter dump happens instead of the full operation. Less profitable, less ecological damage.
event.mafia_waste_dumping.res2_alt: The quiet dump gets discovered during a surprise EPA raid. The fine dwarfs whatever was earned.
event.mafia_waste_dumping.title: Waste Dumping
event.mafia_weapons_ore.desc: International criminal wants ore for weapons. Your shady contacts have been in touch.
event.mafia_weapons_ore.res0: Ore gets sold directly into a weapons deal. Extremely profitable, and extremely hard to justify later. A lucrative special contract lands on the board.
event.mafia_weapons_ore.res1: The arms deal is refused outright. The refusal does not sit well with the buyer.
event.mafia_weapons_ore.res2: A small shipment moves quietly instead of a full deal. Smaller profit, smaller exposure.
event.mafia_weapons_ore.title: Weapons Ore
event.mafia_wedding.desc: Mafia wedding invitation (mandatory attendance). A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_wedding.res0: A lavish gift is sent to the wedding. Expensive, and it buys real goodwill with the family.
event.mafia_wedding.res1: The wedding is skipped entirely. The absence is noted, and not kindly. One employee ends up in the infirmary.
event.mafia_wedding.res1_alt: The wedding is skipped entirely. The absence is noted, and not kindly. Nobody is healthy enough to get hurt, so the injury never happens.
event.mafia_wedding.res2: A modest appearance is made with a modest gift. Polite, sufficient, unmemorable.
event.mafia_wedding.title: Wedding
event.mafia_witness_protection.desc: Witness protection hiding spot. A phone call from an unknown number. You know who it is.
event.mafia_witness_protection.res0: A witness gets hidden somewhere deep in the site. Profitable, and safety takes a real hit. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_witness_protection.res1: The hiding request is refused. The mine stays out of it entirely, and slightly cleaner for it.
event.mafia_witness_protection.res2: A tool shed becomes a makeshift hiding spot. Small cash, small risk, small shed.
event.mafia_witness_protection.title: Witness Protection
event.mafia_zoning_favors.desc: Mob politician offers zoning favors. The family has a new 'opportunity.'
event.mafia_zoning_favors.res0: Zoning officials get bribed to open up restricted land. Expensive, and a genuine ecological setback. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.mafia_zoning_favors.res1: The favors are declined. Zoning stays exactly as restrictive as the law intended.
event.mafia_zoning_favors.res2: A minor rezoning gets pushed through instead of the full favor package.
event.mafia_zoning_favors.title: Zoning Favors
event.politics_activist_investor.desc: Activist investor buys stake. The political landscape shifts once more.
event.politics_activist_investor.res0: Real green reforms are adopted at the investor's insistence. Costly upfront, genuinely better long-term. Upkeep costs 15% less for 7 days.
event.politics_activist_investor.res1: A poison-pill defense blocks the takeover attempt. Legal, aggressive, and quietly corrupting.
event.politics_activist_investor.res2: A negotiated middle ground satisfies nobody completely but keeps the mine's own name on the door.
event.politics_activist_investor.title: Activist Investor
event.politics_ai_replacement.desc: AI threatens to replace all miners (meta-humor). The political landscape shifts once more.
event.politics_ai_replacement.res0: The mine automates aggressively. Safety numbers improve; so does the size of the unemployment line outside the gate. One employee quits on the spot. Crews work 20% faster for 48 hours.
event.politics_ai_replacement.res0_alt: The mine automates aggressively. Safety numbers improve; so does the size of the unemployment line outside the gate. There is nobody left to quit, so nobody does. Crews work 20% faster for 48 hours.
event.politics_ai_replacement.res1: A public 'humans first' pledge is signed. Morale surges; the AI vendor's sales calls do not stop. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.politics_ai_replacement.res2: AI gets deployed as an assistant only, not a replacement. A compromise that satisfies almost nobody completely.
event.politics_ai_replacement.title: Ai Replacement
event.politics_alien_mineral.desc: Alien mineral discovered in your ore (fantastical). The regulatory environment is changing.
event.politics_alien_mineral.res0: The alien mineral sample is sold quietly to military buyers. Extremely profitable, extremely off the books. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.politics_alien_mineral.res1: The sample is donated to a research institute instead. Slower payoff, genuine scientific goodwill.
event.politics_alien_mineral.res2: A guided 'alien mineral tourism' package launches and sells out within days.
event.politics_alien_mineral.res2_alt: The tourism launch triggers a full-blown local panic instead of curiosity. Refunds cost more than the ticket sales.
event.politics_alien_mineral.title: Alien Mineral
event.politics_ambassador_faint.desc: Ambassador's wife fainted during mine tour. The political landscape shifts once more.
event.politics_ambassador_faint.res0: A formal apology and a fruit basket are sent to the embassy. The incident is smoothed over, mostly.
event.politics_ambassador_faint.res1: Responsibility is denied entirely. The embassy does not appreciate being told the fainting was unrelated to the mine.
event.politics_ambassador_faint.res2: An extravagant spa gift basket is sent to the ambassador's residence. Overkill, but effective overkill.
event.politics_ambassador_faint.title: Ambassador Faint
event.politics_archaeology_halt.desc: Government orders archaeological survey (delays). A government official has taken notice of your operation.
event.politics_archaeology_halt.res0: A proper archaeological survey runs its full course. Slow, correct, and expensive. Drilling is banned for 12 hours.
event.politics_archaeology_halt.res1: Inconvenient artifacts get quietly reburied before anyone official arrives to catalogue them.
event.politics_archaeology_halt.res2: A rushed survey satisfies the paperwork requirement without slowing the drill schedule much. Drilling is banned for 24 hours.
event.politics_archaeology_halt.title: Archaeology Halt
event.politics_awards.desc: Mining industry awards ceremony. Politics finds its way to your pit.
event.politics_awards.res0: The delegation attends the industry awards ceremony and walks away with real recognition.
event.politics_awards.res0_alt: The awards trip happens, but nothing is won. A pleasant dinner and an expensed hotel room are the only takeaways.
event.politics_awards.res1: Nobody attends. The ceremony proceeds without the mine, and word gets around about the absence.
event.politics_awards.res2: The judging panel receives a generous 'consulting fee'. An award materializes shortly after. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.politics_awards.title: Awards
event.politics_celebrity.desc: Celebrity endorsement opportunity. The regulatory environment is changing.
event.politics_celebrity.res0: A celebrity endorsement deal is signed. The mine trends online for a week, mostly for the wrong reasons. New contracts pay 15% more for 7 days.
event.politics_celebrity.res1: The opportunity is passed on entirely. The mine remains exactly as obscure as before.
event.politics_celebrity.res2: A cheaper social-media-only endorsement runs instead. A few posts, a modest bump in goodwill.
event.politics_celebrity.title: Celebrity
event.politics_celebrity_protest.desc: Celebrity activist camps at your gate. Politics finds its way to your pit.
event.politics_celebrity_protest.res0: The celebrity activist is engaged directly, publicly, and surprisingly civilly. It defuses most of the media attention.
event.politics_celebrity_protest.res1: The camp-out is ignored entirely. Coverage of the ignoring becomes its own story, and not a flattering one. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.politics_celebrity_protest.res2: The activist is invited on a guided mine tour, hoping to win them over.
event.politics_celebrity_protest.res2_al: The guided tour backfires spectacularly — the activist leaves more horrified than when they arrived.
event.politics_celebrity_protest.title: Celebrity Protest
event.politics_client_scandal.desc: Political scandal implicates your biggest client. Politics finds its way to your pit.
event.politics_client_scandal.res0: Ties with the scandal-hit client are cut cleanly and publicly. Costly in contracts, cheap in reputation risk. A running contract is cancelled.
event.politics_client_scandal.res0_alt: Ties with the scandal-hit client are cut cleanly and publicly. Costly in contracts, cheap in reputation risk. There is no open contract to cancel, so the client has nothing to walk away from.
event.politics_client_scandal.res1: Nothing is said. The contract continues quietly, and a modest kickback sweetens the silence.
event.politics_client_scandal.res2: A carefully worded public statement puts polite distance between the mine and the client, without cutting ties.
event.politics_client_scandal.title: Client Scandal
event.politics_competitor_mine.desc: MegaBlast Corp opens nearby mine. A government official has taken notice of your operation.
event.politics_competitor_mine.res0: Prices are slashed to undercut MegaBlast Corp. Margins vanish, but so does their market share.
event.politics_competitor_mine.res1: A quiet sabotage campaign targets the rival's equipment. Deniable, expensive, effective. Mafia events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.politics_competitor_mine.res2: Their best workers get poached with better offers. MegaBlast Corp is not thrilled about the exodus. A new driller signs on at no cost.
event.politics_competitor_mine.title: Competitor Mine
event.politics_competitor_scandal.desc: Competitor caught in scandal. The political landscape shifts once more.
event.politics_competitor_scandal.res0: Their scandal becomes your opportunity. Contracts get poached mid-crisis, without much subtlety. A lucrative special contract lands on the board.
event.politics_competitor_scandal.res1: The high road is taken. No poaching, no comment, no involvement — and a modest reputational boost for it.
event.politics_competitor_scandal.res2: Additional dirt on the competitor is leaked to the press, anonymously, from a very familiar fax number. Lawsuit events become 2x as frequent for 7 days.
event.politics_competitor_scandal.title: Competitor Scandal
event.politics_currency_crash.desc: Currency devaluation. Politics finds its way to your pit.
event.politics_currency_crash.res0: Import prices surge overnight and every line item on the budget gets uglier. Wages feel it hardest. Upkeep costs 20% more for 10 days.
event.politics_currency_crash.res1: Black-market supplies fill the gap at a discount, cash only, receipts optional.
event.politics_currency_crash.res2: A currency hedge is arranged in advance. It costs more than doing nothing, and it protects morale from the shock. Morale rises by 1 per hour for 24 hours.
event.politics_currency_crash.title: Currency Crash
event.politics_delegation.desc: Foreign delegation tour (impress for contracts). A government official has taken notice of your operation.
event.politics_delegation.res0: The delegation tour goes flawlessly. Contracts practically sign themselves afterward.
event.politics_delegation.res0_alt: The delegation tour goes fine, not flawlessly. A small stumble keeps the enthusiasm merely polite.
event.politics_delegation.res1: The tour is rushed through in half the scheduled time. The delegation notices the corners cut. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.politics_delegation.res2: A direct bribe smooths the delegation's report before it is even written.
event.politics_delegation.title: Delegation
event.politics_diplomatic_incident.desc: The embassy did not enjoy hearing that the ambassador's fainting spell was not your problem. A government official has taken notice of your operation.
event.politics_diplomatic_incident.res0: A formal diplomatic apology and an embassy gift smooth over the ambassador's fainting spell.
event.politics_diplomatic_incident.res1: The mine blames the altitude for the fainting. The mine is not, notably, at high altitude.
event.politics_diplomatic_incident.res2: A discounted ore trade deal compensates the embassy in a currency everyone understands: money. New contracts pay 20% less for 7 days.
event.politics_diplomatic_incident.title: Diplomatic Incident
event.politics_documentary.desc: Mining documentary crew arrives. The regulatory environment is changing.
